title: 1637 Prairie's wing wears the cornice
items: The wing at the south end of 1637 Prairie Avenue now carries the house's bracketed cornice round its three faces, so its band reads as deep as the main cornice's, as the engraving of Jesse Spalding's remodel draws it.
A painted block stands in that band over the wing's window, rising just above it, where the engraving draws one.
